name: Zack Fair
oracle_text:
Zack Fair enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
{1}, Sacrifice Zack Fair: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. Put Zack Fair's counters on that creature and attach an Equipment that was attached to Zack Fair to that creature.
blocked_sentences: {1}, Sacrifice Zack Fair: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. Put Zack Fair's counters on that creature and attach an Equipment that was attached to Zack Fair to that creature.

needs.what: Last-known information of a permanent sacrificed as an activation cost, readable when the ability resolves: every kind and amount of counter it had (to put that many of each kind on the target), and the set of Equipment that were attached to it as it left (so an `attach` can pick one of them and attach it to the target)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `counters_had` and `auras_had` read the `had_counters`/`had_auras` bindings that only a leaves/dies trigger event supplies, so an activated ability whose cost sacrificed its source reads 0; `move_counters` needs its source still on the battlefield; `costs.bind_paid_object` records only power/toughness of a paid object; `_equipment_had` snapshots only a count of Equipment, not which ones, and nothing exposes it to a selector; the `attached`/`attached_to` selectors see the live board, where the Equipment is already unattached by resolution
